battle.name: 芬蘭內戰
battle.brief: 一九一八年一月二十七日，芬蘭白軍與赤衛隊在南部與卡累利阿地峽全面開火。卡面這件毛瑟G98步槍，正是白軍主力——受德國訓練的第二十七獵兵團與德軍波羅的海師——的制式步槍，與紅軍手中的莫辛-納甘形成明顯代差。四月三日德軍攻入坦佩雷，五月維堡陷落，紅軍節節退向卡累利阿。

kit.name: 毛瑟G98步槍
kit.history: 作為德國國防軍的制式步槍，Gewehr 98 在一次大戰期間被廣泛配發至步兵排，並被多國軍隊引進或仿製。

countries: 芬蘭內戰的交戰方分成白色芬蘭與紅色芬蘭兩個板塊。白方以元老院組成的參議院為最高權力，議會授權政府自建軍隊，內閣總理斯維努夫約夫隨政府退到瓦薩，另設臨時政府；白軍由北方自耕農組成的義勇保護隊（Suojeluskunta）、受德國訓練的芬蘭獵兵第二十七團、德國波羅的海師與第五獵兵團（芬德軍團），以及瑞典志願兵團拼成，指揮權於一九一八年二月底集中到曼納海姆手中。德國以提供武裝與部隊為由，取得在芬蘭派兵並限制芬蘭對外談判的實際權力。紅方以芬蘭社會民主黨為政治核心，各區工人組織軍事委員會統率赤衛隊，赫爾辛基的「芬蘭人民代表團」在一九一八年一月宣布行使國家權力，得到俄羅斯蘇維埃政權的軍火輸送與軍事顧問支援。英、法為保護波羅的海上的商船另派小型分遣隊，僅在近海監視，並未投入地面戰。
countriesEn: The opposing sides in the Finnish Civil War were the two political blocs of White Finland and Red Finland. The Whites, whose supreme authority was the Senate that replaced the old Diet, were a government empowered by the parliament to raise an army; Prime Minister Pehr Svinufjov moved with the government to Vaasa, where a provisional administration was established. Their army was an amalgamation of the civil guard (Suojeluskunta) raised by northern smallholders, the Finnish 27th Jäger Regiment trained in Germany, the German Baltic Sea Division and the 5th Jäger Regiment (the Finnish-German Legion), and the Swedish Volunteer Corps; command was concentrated in the hands of Mannerheim at the end of February 1918. Germany supplied the arms and the troops, and in exchange obtained the practical right to station forces in Finland and to limit the Finnish government's freedom to negotiate. The Reds were politically led by the Finnish Social Democratic Party, with the Red Guard directed through workers' military committees in each district; in Helsinki the Finnish People's Delegation claimed state authority in January 1918 and received arms shipments and military advisers from Soviet Russia. Britain and France sent small detachments to the Baltic to protect merchant shipping, but stayed clear of the fighting on land.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩個陣營。白色芬蘭方面，前俄國陸軍中將卡爾·古斯塔夫·埃米爾·曼納海姆是一九一八年二月底被任命的白軍總司令，他以北方自耕農為後盾，在瓦薩、博特亞與卡累利阿重新編組義勇兵，主張以德式縱隊與斜射火力作戰；德方前線指揮是波羅的海師師長呂迪格·馮·德·戈爾茨，第五獵兵團團長漢斯·卡爾姆率領德籍與芬籍志願兵在南部登陸；德國駐芬軍事代表團團長漢斯·馮·德·戈爾茨是政策層面的操盤者，他與前者的關係是同族而非同一人；瑞典志願兵團則由艾里克·塔德率隊。紅色芬蘭方面，人民代表團主席奧托·維勒·庫伊西寧主持「紅芬蘭」的國家機構，赫爾辛基赤衛隊的實戰指揮是庫爾韋羅·曼納，坦佩雷守軍由代號「約翰」的艾力克松率領，北方游擊隊則以化名運作。一九一八年四月，芬蘭政府要求德軍把軍隊指揮權移交德籍將領並全面改採德式編制，曼納海姆拒絕交出軍令權，這段交涉成為德軍五月撤出芬蘭的直接導火線之一。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities belong to the two camps. On the White side, Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim, a former major general of the Russian imperial army, was appointed commander-in-chief of the White forces at the end of February 1918; leaning on the northern smallholders, he reorganized the volunteers in Vaasa, Ostrobothnia and Karelia, and pressed for German-style columns and oblique fire. The German commander on the ground was General Rüdiger von der Goltz, commander of the Baltic Sea Division, while Hans Kalm led the 5th Jäger Regiment of German and Finnish volunteers that landed in the south. Hans von der Goltz, head of the German military mission in Finland, ran the political side of German policy; he was a kinsman, not the same person, of the general above. The Swedish Volunteer Corps was led by Erik Thåder. On the Red side, Otto Wille Kuusinen, chairman of the People's Delegation, presided over the institutions of Red Finland; Kullervo Manner handled the actual command of the Red Guard in Helsinki; the garrison of Tampere was commanded by a man known by the nom de guerre Johan; and the northern guerrilla bands worked under assumed names. In April 1918 the Finnish government demanded that the German troops be handed over to German officers and reorganized entirely along German lines; Mannerheim refused to surrender the command, and this friction was one of the immediate causes of the German withdrawal in May.
kits: 卡面這件毛瑟G98步槍（Gewehr 98）是一八九八年起列裝的德國制式步槍：七點九二乘五七公釐口徑、五發固定彈倉、槍管長六百四十公厘、連刺刀約重四點一公斤、槍口初速約八百四十公尺每秒，標尺可刻到兩千米，實戰常用有效射程六百至八百米。第一次世界大戰期間德國生產逾一千一百萬支，是德軍步兵排的基本火力單位，也是白軍這支以德式訓練與德式編制為骨架的部隊手中最原生的一支槍。第二十七獵兵團與德國波羅的海師、第五獵兵團都以G98為制式步槍，另有毛瑟手槍作為軍官與傳令兵的副武器，MG 08重機槍與MG 08/15輕機槍配屬於各營。火力支援方面，德軍帶來七點七厘米FK 96野戰炮、十點五厘米leFH 16輕野戰炮與十五厘米榴彈炮，芬蘭白軍另有自有的七點六厘米野炮與火車炮。紅軍的步槍以帝俄留下的莫辛-納甘M91與M95為主，芬蘭境內軍械庫中的莫辛-納甘估計有三萬四千至四萬一千支，另有較舊的別爾丹步槍，配七六毫米野炮、馬克西姆M1910重機槍與大量黑火藥及劣質彈藥；卡累利阿線上紅軍還有裝甲列車與裝甲汽車。芬蘭海防序列中的海防戰列艦「維納莫寧」與「伊爾馬寧」一九一八年才抵達，未能投入內戰；空軍則剛起步，一九一八年春由德軍與芬軍開始用飛機偵察，芬蘭空軍正式建制在一九一九年。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Mauser Gewehr 98, entered German service in 1898: calibre 7.92 x 57 mm, a five-round internal box magazine, a 640 mm barrel, about 4.1 kg in weight with bayonet, a muzzle velocity near 840 metres per second, a sight graduated to 2,000 metres and a practical effective range of some 600 to 800 metres. More than eleven million were produced in Germany during the First World War; it was the basic firepower unit of the German infantry platoon and it was also the most native weapon in the hands of the Whites, whose training and organization were German to the bone. The 27th Jäger Regiment, the German Baltic Sea Division and the 5th Jäger Regiment all carried the Gewehr 98 as their standard rifle; Mauser pistols served as side arms for officers and messengers, and MG 08 heavy machine guns with MG 08/15 light machine guns were distributed down to battalion level. For fire support the Germans brought 7.7 cm FK 96 field guns, 10.5 cm leFH 16 light field howitzers and 15 cm howitzers, while the Finnish Whites fielded their own 7.6 cm guns and railway artillery. The Red infantry were armed mainly with Mosin-Nagant M91 and M95 rifles left behind by the imperial Russian army; the imperial depots inside Finland held an estimated 34,000 to 41,000 Mosin-Nagants, alongside older Berdan rifles, 76 mm field guns, Maxim M1910 heavy machine guns and a great deal of black powder and poor ammunition. The Reds also used armoured trains and armoured cars on the Karelian railway. The coastal defence ships Väinämöinen and Ilmarinen of the Finnish naval list only reached Finland in 1918 and saw no service in the civil war; Finnish aviation was in its infancy, with German and Finnish machines beginning reconnaissance in the spring of 1918, and the Finnish Air Force was formally organized only in 1919.
tactics: 白軍的戰術骨架是德式獵兵戰法：排分散成散兵線，利用樹線、房屋與土壘遮蔽，採「射擊後即移動」的躍進，火力與機動交替，一個排的G98步槍齊射可以拉出數百米的橫幅彈幕。突擊時以連排交替掩護，迫擊炮與手榴彈先清理村鎮街巷；芬蘭的深冬、積雪與低溫迫使縱隊改用雪橇與滑雪隊長距離運動，馬匹仍是最重要的牽引與供應手段，冬季白軍的機動性因此明顯高於紅軍。紅軍的戰術接近俄式人民戰爭：以大縱隊夜間行軍，利用裝甲列車與火車炮在卡累利阿鐵路軸線上打擊，進攻時以密集縱隊一次湧上，不顧傷亡，最後以手榴彈與近戰解決；赫爾辛基的市區戰則是密集巷戰與機槍封鎖，紅軍依靠密集人數在市區巷弄中抵擋白軍的縱隊火力。白軍的取勝關鍵，在於把分散的義勇兵改編成能連續作戰的營級部隊，並以德軍重炮與工兵爆破配合，逐點攻取坦佩雷這類環城鐵路樞紐，最終切斷紅軍在南部與卡累利阿之間的鐵路聯繫。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of the White army was the German Jäger way of fighting: the platoon spread out into skirmish lines, used tree lines, houses and earth banks for cover, and advanced by fire and movement, so that a single volley from a platoon of Gewehr 98 rifles could lay down a several-hundred-metre curtain of fire. Assaults were covered platoon by platoon, with mortars and hand grenades clearing the streets of villages first. Finnish deep winter, snow and low temperatures forced columns to travel on sledges and ski detachments over long distances, and horses remained the principal means of traction and supply, which gave the Whites markedly better mobility than the Reds in winter. Red tactics resembled the Russian form of people's war: large columns moving at night, armoured trains and railway guns working along the Karelian rail axis, massed formations thrown forward in a single rush regardless of casualties, and the issue settled at last by grenades and close combat. In Helsinki the fighting was dense street combat with machine-gun blocks, the Reds relying on their numbers in the narrow streets to hold back the fire of White columns. The White key to victory was to reorganize scattered volunteers into units capable of continuous combat, and to combine German heavy artillery with engineer demolition so as to take the rail hubs such as Tampere point by point, finally cutting the railway that tied Red southern Finland to Red Karelia.
data: 時間軸：內戰自一九一八年一月二十七日全面開火，至五月十五日卡累利阿地峽赤衛隊投降，前後不足四個月。兵力：白軍總數約三萬五千至三萬七千人，其中芬蘭義勇兵與獵兵約二萬五千人、德國波羅的海師約一萬四千人（各期統計在一萬四千至兩萬七千人之間）、瑞典志願兵團約三千八百人、第二十七獵兵團回國者約一千二百六十人；紅軍約二萬五千至四萬人，二月高峰接近四萬，雙方合計約七萬人。武器：紅軍自帝俄在芬蘭的軍械庫取得莫辛-納甘步槍三萬四千至四萬一支、重機槍約五百挺、七六毫米野炮數十門，並有裝甲列車兩列；白軍方面，第二十七獵兵團返國時攜帶的G98步槍有「約八千支」之說，但數字存疑，德軍各部隊則一律按G98配發。坦佩雷之戰是全役最烈的一戰，雙方投入四萬至五萬人，紅軍陣亡約二千五百至三千五百人，白軍陣亡約一千至一千五百人，受傷合計逾一萬人，總死亡逾四千人，各方統計出入頗大。全役白軍陣亡約五千至六千五百人，紅軍陣亡約八千至九千人。
dataEn: Chronology: the civil war broke out in full on 27 January 1918 and ended when the Red Guard in the Karelian Isthmus laid down its arms on 15 May, a span of less than four months. Strength: the Whites numbered roughly 35,000 to 37,000 men, of whom about 25,000 were Finnish volunteers and Jägers, some 14,000 belonged to the German Baltic Sea Division (estimates for the German contingent range from 14,000 to 27,000 over the course of the campaign), the Swedish Volunteer Corps counted about 3,800, and the returning 27th Jäger Regiment about 1,260. The Reds numbered about 25,000 to 40,000, approaching 40,000 at their peak in February, giving roughly 70,000 men in all. Weapons: the Reds took from the imperial depots inside Finland an estimated 34,000 to 41,000 Mosin-Nagant rifles, around 500 heavy machine guns and several dozen 76 mm field guns, together with two armoured trains; on the White side the claim that the returning 27th Jäger Regiment brought some 8,000 Gewehr 98 rifles with it is frequently quoted but should be treated with caution, while all German units were issued to the Gewehr 98 as standard. The battle of Tampere was the fiercest of the war: between 40,000 and 50,000 men were committed, the Reds lost roughly 2,500 to 3,500 dead and the Whites roughly 1,000 to 1,500, more than 10,000 were wounded, and the combined death toll exceeded 4,000, with considerable disagreement between the published figures. For the campaign as a whole, White military deaths are usually put at 5,000 to 6,500 and Red military deaths at 8,000 to 9,000.
cause: 內戰的根源是俄羅斯帝國在第一次世界大戰東線的崩解。芬蘭長期是帝國內高度自治的大公國，一九〇六年議會改革給予男女普選，投票人由十二萬增至一百二十七萬，社會民主黨隨即取得過半選票，勞工運動與主張地方自治的芬蘭菁英在同一套議會框架內正面衝突。一九一七年七月危機使社會民主黨政府倒台；十一月革命後，芬蘭議會於十一月二十七日宣稱自己是主權的持有者，十二月四日宣布獨立，德國在一九一八年三月簽訂布列斯特和約時正式承認。帝國駐芬部隊解散後，大量軍械流入民間，農民與工人雙方都迅速武裝；赤衛隊在列寧與托洛茨基的推動下得到俄方的軍火與顧問，白方則得到德國的資金與軍事援助——德國插手東歐的戰略目標，是借道芬蘭進攻彼得格勒與科拉半島。芬蘭自身也不願在未定國體的權力真空內長期運作，雙方最終選擇以武裝鬥爭決定國家統治權歸屬。
causeEn: The roots of the civil war lie in the collapse of the Russian empire on the eastern front of the First World War. Finland had long been a highly autonomous grand duchy within the empire; the parliamentary reform of 1906 introduced universal suffrage for men and women, raising the electorate from 120,000 to 1.27 million, and the Social Democratic Party immediately won a majority of the votes. The labour movement and the Finnish elite who wanted local autonomy now collided head on inside the same parliamentary framework. The July crisis of 1917 brought down the Social Democratic government; after the November revolution the Finnish parliament declared on 27 November that it held sovereign power, and on 4 December independence was proclaimed, formally recognized by Germany in the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk in March 1918. Once the imperial garrison in Finland was demobilized, large quantities of arms flowed into private hands, and both peasants and workers armed themselves. The Red Guard drew arms and advisers from Russia under Lenin's and Trotsky's pressure, while the Whites received German money and military assistance; German interest in the Baltic was strategic, aimed at driving the army through Finland towards Petrograd and the Kola Peninsula. Finland itself had no wish to drift for long in a power vacuum without a settled form of government, and both sides ended by choosing armed struggle to decide who would govern the country.
impact: 內戰的結果重塑了芬蘭的國家性格。白軍勝利後，義勇兵被整編為常備的芬蘭陸軍（一九一八年八月成軍，一九二一年改稱芬蘭國防軍），第二十七獵兵團與北方白軍骨幹構成建軍核心；曼納海姆則以救國英雄的地位長期主導軍政，他主張國家利益高於黨派，這一取向日後在二戰中讓芬蘭對納粹德國保持距離。政治上，紅軍的失敗伴隨大規模鎮壓，被稱為白色恐怖，官方調查提出約一萬二千五百名赤衛隊成員死於戰俘營，但數字仍有爭議；許多紅軍支持者連同家屬北遷俄羅斯，一九一八至一九二〇年間移居者約十五萬至二十萬人，芬蘭社會的裂痕直到一九三九年的冬季戰爭才重新凝聚。外交上，德國干預留下的記憶使芬蘭在國際上被視為德國的附庸，反而推動芬蘭向英美靠攏，並在紅色恐慌下長期維持對蘇俄的戒心；芬蘭海軍與空軍也以內戰為契機逐步建立。一九二〇年十月十四日的塔爾圖和約最終解決芬蘇邊界爭端，蘇聯事後仍對新國界深感不安。
impactEn: The outcome of the civil war reshaped the national character of Finland. After the White victory the volunteers were reorganized into a regular army, the Finnish Army being formed in August 1918 and renamed the Finnish Defence Forces in 1921; the 27th Jäger Regiment and the northern White cadre formed the core of the new force. Mannerheim emerged as the saviour of the country and long dominated military and political life, insisting that the national interest stood above party; that attitude later kept Finland at a distance from Nazi Germany during the Second World War. Politically, the defeat of the Reds was followed by large-scale reprisals known as the White Terror; an official inquiry put the number of Red Guard members who died in prison camps at about 12,500, though the figure remains disputed. Many Red sympathizers and their families fled north to Russia, with estimates of 150,000 to 200,000 emigrants in 1918 to 1920, and the fracture in Finnish society was not healed until the Winter War of 1939. Diplomatically, the memory of German intervention left Finland internationally branded as a German client, which pushed the country towards Britain and the United States, and the red panic kept Finland permanently wary of Soviet Russia. The Finnish navy and air force also grew out of the war. The Treaty of Tartu of 14 October 1920 finally settled the Finnish-Soviet border dispute, though Moscow remained deeply uneasy about the new line.
result: 白軍取得全面勝利。一九一八年一月二十五日白軍一度收復赫爾辛基，紅軍在二十六日反攻，二十八日白軍完全控制首都，紅軍殘部退往鄉村；瓦薩與奧盧分別於二月三日與二月一日易手，二月二十日白軍攻入拉赫蒂，三月初佔領庫奧皮奧；四月三日德軍與獵兵團在猛烈炮火準備後攻入坦佩雷，守軍一部被殲、一部北撤，四月二十九日白軍進入維堡，五月八日佔領索塔瓦拉，五月十五日卡累利阿地峽的赤衛隊放下武器，內戰結束。紅軍的武裝組織在北方解散，部分成員日後加入芬蘭共產主義者的隊伍；芬蘭議會於五月通過新憲法，確立議會制共和國，總統權力受議會節制，白軍政府的正統性由此確立。德軍在五月陸續撤出芬蘭，一九一八年十二月德國王子費德里希·卡爾放棄接受芬蘭王位，德方影響至此告終，芬蘭轉而走向獨立的中立國家道路。
resultEn: The Whites won outright. On 25 January 1918 the Whites briefly retook Helsinki, the Reds counter-attacked on the 26th, and by the 28th the Whites held the capital completely, the Red remnants withdrawing into the countryside. Vaasa and Oulu changed hands on 3 and 1 February respectively, the Whites entered Lahti on 20 February, and Kuopio fell in early March. On 3 April the Germans and the Jägers stormed Tampere after a heavy artillery preparation, part of the garrison being destroyed and part escaping north; on 29 April the Whites entered Vyborg, on 8 May they occupied Sortavala, and on 15 May the Red Guard in the Karelian Isthmus laid down its arms, ending the war. The Red organizations dissolved in the north, and some of their members later entered the Finnish communist movement. In May the Finnish parliament passed a new constitution establishing a parliamentary republic in which the president's powers were checked by parliament, and the legitimacy of the White government was thereby settled. German troops withdrew from Finland through May, and in December 1918 the German prince Frederick Charles renounced the Finnish crown, ending German influence and leaving Finland on the road to an independent, neutral state.
